Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: Play Map ID
Fields.Description: Map the cutscene plays in, as an 8-digit number (m60_49_53_00 → 60495300). 0: taken from the cutscene ID (sAA_BB → mAA_BB_00_00). In multiplayer, a player who doesn't have this map and every Require Map ID loaded, or whose current map is overworld (m50–m88) when this map isn't (or the reverse), can't play the cutscene; with 0 here, no one in multiplayer can.

Fields.Name: Require Map ID 0
Fields.Description: Extra map that must be loaded for a player in multiplayer to play the cutscene (see Play Map ID), as an 8-digit number. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Loading Camera Collision ID
Fields.Description: Collision hNNNNNN of the play map that the cutscene looks up while loading, for its camera position. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Guest Progress Bar Time
Fields.Description: Seconds, passed with the cutscene's settings; probably how long the progress bar runs on the screen shown to a multiplayer player who can't play the cutscene (see Play Map ID).

Fields.Name: Wait-for Collision [0]
Fields.Description: Collision hNNNNNN of the play map that the cutscene waits for while loading (its hit area is added to the cutscene's load list). -1: none.
